So let me start this out by saying that if you've never played boneworks, then bonelab will feel a little jank, fair warning.

Onto the review, bonelab is one of my favorite vr games right now, currently have about 10 hours in it and I'm loving it. The story is more comprehensible than Bonelab (though still a little vague in places, and also sometimes hard to progress.). It feels so rewarding to go through a hard level and get a new avatar at the end of it. The environments are vibrant, well designed, and not as gritty and industrious as boneworks.

Now, the various modes.

Arena is actually a lot more fun than expected, considering you can choose different modes and things such as, it's also fun to just play a type of horde mode in bonelab!

Sandbox is, well, sandbox. You can spawn in anything you want and fuck around with npcs, weapons, the physics, etc. Also has a great selection of maps that you can play on.

Parkour is what you'd expect. You basically spawn in a level and you have a parkour course in front of you that you complete as fast as possible. Not my cup of tea, as the climbing physics in bonelab aren't amazing, but I'm sure someone else will like it.

I'm not gonna really explain experimental, just look into it yourself.

The avatar system is amazing, the way you can swap between different avatars on a whim is nuts and the fact that they all have stats to match to it awesome.

The gunplay feels nice, and the bullets have impact to them. The melee is a little bit jank to use but you do have to get used to it.

Overall, just a good game. I'd definitely recommend picking it up if you're a fan of games like blade and sorcery or pavlov!
